contributors_ruleset_user_unique.name: contributors_ruleset_user_unique
contributors_ruleset_user_unique.where: status IN ('Pending', 'Active') AND deleted_at IS NULL

contributors_email_or_user.name: contributors_email_or_user
contributors_email_or_user.value: (user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (email IS NOT NULL)

inventory_check.name: inventory_check
inventory_check.value: (total_charges IS NULL) OR ((total_charges >= 0) AND (remaining_charges IS NOT NULL))

inventory_check1.name: inventory_check1
inventory_check1.value: (remaining_charges IS NULL) OR ((remaining_charges >= 0) AND (total_charges IS NOT NULL))

invites_user_or_email_check.name: invites_user_or_email_check
invites_user_or_email_check.value: (user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (email IS NOT NULL)

requirements_check.name: requirements_check
requirements_check.value: (chaining_operator = ANY (ARRAY['and'::text, 'or'::text])) AND (((chaining_operator IS NULL) AND (operator IS NOT NULL) AND (value IS NOT NULL) AND (value_type IS NOT NULL) AND (target IS NOT NULL)) OR ((chaining_operator IS NOT NULL) AND (operator IS NULL) AND (value IS NULL) AND (value_type IS NULL) AND (target IS NULL)))
